@notice Deploys a new UserBeaconProxy pointing at this beacon.
 @param data Initialization calldata forwarded to the proxy constructor.

devdoc.details: Combines UpgradeableBeacon with a proxy-deployment helper so callers can spin      up new proxies in one transaction.

BeaconInvalidImplementation(address).details: The `implementation` of the beacon is invalid.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

params.deployer: The caller that requested the proxy deployment.
params.proxy: The address of the newly created proxy.

Upgraded(address).details: Emitted when the implementation returned by the beacon is changed.

params.data: Initialization calldata forwarded to the proxy constructor.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

upgradeTo(address).details: Upgrades the beacon to a new implementation. Emits an {Upgraded} event. Requirements: - msg.sender must be the owner of the contract. - `newImplementation` must be a contract.

devdoc.title: FactoryBeacon

BeaconProxyCreated(address,address).notice: Emitted when a new beacon proxy is deployed via this factory.

createBeaconProxy(bytes).notice: Deploys a new UserBeaconProxy pointing at this beacon.

userdoc.notice: Beacon that can deploy fresh UserBeaconProxy instances pointing at itself.
